versions.content: Compatibility of VariableDataPrototype typed by an AR- RAY in a RPortPrototype and a SystemSignal to which the VariableDat- aPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiverToSignalMapping If a Variable- DataPrototype in a RPortPrototype typed by ApplicationArrayDataType that fulfills the rules for a primitive Data Mapping according to [TPS_SYST_02084] is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalMapping to a SystemSignal then the following conditions shall be fulfilled by the VariableDataPrototype and the Sys- temSignal : • if the VariableDataPrototype defines dataConstr s in DataPrototype. swDataDefProps then the dataConstr s shall be compatible to the dataCon- str s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_9374]. • if the VariableDataPrototype is not defining dataConstr s in Dat- aPrototype.swDataDefProps then dataConstr s of DataPrototype.sw- DataDefProps defined on ApplicationArrayElement that is aggregated by the ApplicationArrayDataType shall be compatible to the dataConstr s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_9374].
